At Lazaris

Photos from the Google listing of the bakery bar.

A bakery in an old town house

Lazaris BakeryBar is at Ayiou Lazarou 37-39, on the square of the Church of Agios Lazaros. According to an article from 2019, the building dates from the late 19th century and was a coffee house for many years; the bakery bar opened here in 2017. The bakery is at the heart of the menu: sourdough breads, traditional pies and sweets, sandwiches, salads and small plates, from breakfast to dinner. Guests write about the sourdough, the Cypriot breakfast, the many vegetarian and vegan options and the friendly staff. There are tables inside and outside.

The website field of the Google listing only leads to the Facebook page. Checked on 23 September 2026.
